title: eBus device profile (advisory composition)
description: An advisory composition for one energy.ebus.device.* model: which capabilities each device type in the model typically publishes, and the spec's capability-level Req guidance where it states one. It is NOT an exhaustive or required property set. Properties are MAY by default (framework principle 8); a publisher publishes what it has (principle 3) and its runtime Homie `$description` is authoritative for what it actually publishes. How to publish each individual property lives in the capability catalogs (kind: capability-catalog). Generated from the data-model Markdown; see conventions/property-json.md.

capabilities.description: capability node id -> how this device type composes that capability

req.description: the model's capability-level guidance for this device type, where it states one; absent means the model does not (the default is MAY, per framework principle 8). SHOULD means the device type typically publishes this capability; MUST is reserved for a capability every conformant publisher of the type can supply. It never means the device must have the underlying function: see framework.md, Conformance Latitude.
